name: Chris Carter
bio:
Chris Carter is a highly skilled tattoo artist specializing in illustrative, black & gray, and anime styles, known for creating visually stunning pieces with solid black and vibrant color work. Based in Chillán, Chile, Chris maintains a professional approach to his craft, with a clear communication policy highlighting that bookings are to be made through means other than phone calls, ensuring a smooth and well-organized experience for his clients.
